caseNameFull: Alex M. AZAR, II, Secretary of Health and Human Services v. ALLINA HEALTH SERVICES

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit granted limited to the following question: Whether 42 U.S.C. § 1395hh(a)(2) or § 1395hh(a)(4) required the Department of Health and Human Services to conduct notice-and-comment rulemaking before providing the challenged instructions to a Medicare Administrator Contractor making initial determinations of payments due under Medicare.
